info.description: Consumer enquiries sent to a dealer from /find-dealer. HOLDS CONSUMER PII (name, email, phone, message) — the `find` and `findOne` actions must NEVER be granted to the Public role. Only `create` (via routes/dealer-enquiry.ts, auth: false) is public. Since /find-dealer switched to listing dealers pulled from Caravea Connect, an enquiry usually has NO local dealer row to relate to: it carries `dealerExternalId` (Connect's submission_id) and an empty `dealer` relation. `dealerName` is always resolved from a trusted source (the local row, or Connect's own response) and never taken from the request body.
